summary: A collection of educational cryptographic implementations for an Information Theory course, featuring a classical Decimation block cipher and an LFSR-based stream cipher with cross-platform UI.
key_features: Automatic key validation and GCD correction
LFSR Stream Cipher with 30-bit state register
Byte-wise XOR encryption for various file types
achievements: Implemented modular arithmetic for encryption/decryption including iterative modular inverse resolution. Developed a custom LFSR using bitwise operations for keystream generation. Designed extensible architecture with interfaces and MVVM patterns. Validated bit-perfect data recovery across multiple file formats.
